description: Return the x402 payment challenge (v1 JSON body plus, when the server sends it, the decoded v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as paymentRequired) for purchasing a public credit pack from an endpoint that exposes /e/:slug?action=purchase.

clientReferenceId.description: Optional client reference ID forwarded to the purchase flow

metadata.description: Optional metadata object forwarded to the purchase flow

slug.description: Endpoint slug for the credit-enabled endpoint

walletAddress.description: Optional wallet address to receive the purchased credits when the underlying endpoint supports it

name: request_endpoint_credit_purchase_payment
